summary: The human prompt requested a replication of Paper P, followed by a request to create an isolated virtual environment. The agent conducted an exceptionally rigorous static audit, checking repository paths, notebook data flow, stored outputs, and live URL headers, producing both an audit report and a 14-section two-track replication plan. However, the agent remained entirely in plan-and-environment mode, explicitly stating that no packages were installed and no replication experiments were run. Consequently, no MUSE vectors were downloaded and no replication targets were computed, though the agent accurately identified critical paper-code discrepancies and missing assets.
